action.description: Skill action: 'create' writes a new instruction skill, 'install' adds one from a source, 'update' refreshes an installed one, 'enable' and 'disable' toggle one, 'validate' checks one, 'sync' synchronizes the community skill repositories, 'remove' deletes one

description.description: Short description of the skill; required for 'create'

name.description: Workspace skill name; required for 'create', 'update', 'enable', 'disable', 'validate' and 'remove'

source.description: Git URL or explicit local directory; required for 'install'. For 'lifecycle_import_executable', the directory of the reviewed executable bundle
